summary: Controller exposes Prometheus metrics at /api/v2/metrics. Key performance metrics: awx_status_total, awx_instance_remaining_capacity, callback_receiver_event_processing_avg_seconds (job events lag), callback_receiver_events_insert_db and callback_receiver_events_queue_size_redis, where a high queue can cause OOM.
questions: Where are Prometheus metrics for automation controller?
Control node running out of memory because of Redis queue

answer_card.title: Key controller metrics at /api/v2/metrics
answer_card.answer_md:
| Metric | Use |
|---|---|
| `awx_status_total` | jobs per status, spot failure spikes |
| `awx_instance_remaining_capacity` | capacity left for jobs |
| `callback_receiver_event_processing_avg_seconds` | job events lag |
| `callback_receiver_events_insert_db` | event insert rate |
| `callback_receiver_events_queue_size_redis` | backlog; too high risks OOM |
